home.needsYouEmpty: Nothing needs you right now. Enjoy the calm.

workspace.boardPlaceholder: The {name} board lands in a later slice.
workspace.queuePlaceholder: Decisions waiting on you will appear here.

hiring.computedNote: S_tech is the weighted mean of the four dimension means; σ is the population standard deviation across independent extraction runs. Same input, same score.
hiring.noEvidence: No evidence reference recorded for this dimension.

import.title: Import applications
import.csvHelp: Columns: name, email, links (optional), cv (optional filename).
import.cvsHelp: Upload CVs first, then reference them in the cv column by filename.
import.previewEmpty: Paste or drop a CSV to preview the rows.
import.consent: Every candidate on this list has consented to evaluation.

errors.empty: The CSV has no candidate rows.
errors.tooMany: Too many rows: the batch limit is {{count}}.
errors.badHeader: The CSV needs name and email columns.
errors.unknownCv: Row {{line}}: CV file is not uploaded.

jobs.title: Job specifications
jobs.empty: No jobs yet. Create the first specification.
jobs.formHint: Weights must match the role; they are recorded with the job and used for every score.

fields.title: Title
fields.weightsHelp: Non-negative, summing to 1.0; recorded per job for reproducible scoring.
fields.jobFamilyHint: Selects the scoring rubric. Candidates are measured against the evidence their own field produces.

errors.yearsInvalid: Minimum years must be a whole number between 0 and 60.
errors.weightsNumber: Each weight must be a non-negative number.
errors.conflict: The job changed elsewhere or is closed — reload and try again.
errors.failed: Could not save the job. Please try again.
errors.transitionFailed: Could not change the status. Please try again.

form.hint: Terms are recorded as an append-only revision; nothing reaches the candidate until you queue the offer message.

dialog.submitHint: The offer enters the shared approval queue; a named HR approver decides.
dialog.approveHint: Signs the linked approval in your name; the offer can then be messaged to the candidate.
dialog.withdrawHint: Withdraws the offer and any pending approval; a reason is required.
dialog.messageHint: Queues the candidate-facing message through the outbox; leave the body blank to use the terms template.
dialog.acceptHint: Records that the candidate accepted. A human relays the decision — nothing auto-accepts.
dialog.declineHint: Records that the candidate declined; a reason is required.

fields.bodyPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the terms template
fields.subject: Subject (optional)

errors.salaryInvalid: Salary must be a non-negative number.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date must be after the start date.
errors.pkwtNeedsEnd: Fixed-term (PKWT) offers require an end date.
errors.probationInvalid: Probation must be a whole number between 0 and 12.
errors.draftOnly: Only draft offers can be revised.
errors.approvalRejected: The linked approval was rejected; create a new offer instead.
errors.conflict: The offer cannot change in its current state.
errors.failed: Could not save the offer. Please try again.

chat.empty: Ask a question to get started.
chat.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
chat.newSubject: New subject — started a fresh conversation.

review.title: Human sign-off
review.empty: No gated applications. Nothing waits on you here.
review.notesPlaceholder: What the candidate should hear, or why this is safe
review.receiptNote: Append-only: overrides are never edited or deleted.
review.awaitingEvaluation: Waiting for the evaluation to register.

errors.agentBlocked: Reviewers must be named humans, not agents.
errors.forbidden: That reviewer is not permitted to sign off.
errors.conflict: The request conflicts with the current state.
errors.failed: Could not record the decision. Please try again.

communication.title: Candidate communication
communication.needsEvaluation: Communication is available once the evaluation is registered.
communication.rejectionLocked: Rejection queueing unlocks after a recorded rejection decision (a human override or a documented automatic rejection).
communication.rejectionExists: A rejection message already exists for this candidate.
communication.dispatchFailed: Still queued — {{provider}} could not send it: {{error}}
communication.repliesHint: Captured from the connected mailbox. A reply is evidence only — accepting an offer or moving a stage stays a human decision.

fields.subject: Subject
fields.toEmailHint: Optional. With an email transport connected, the queued message is carried to this address; leave it blank to keep sending it yourself.
fields.toPhoneHint: Optional. Used to build a wa.me link you open in WhatsApp; the system never sends on its own.

dialogs.rejectionHint: The message is composed from the candidate's grounded feedback report. Preview it first — queueing stores it but never sends it; record dispatch yourself.
dialogs.offerHint: You write the offer; queueing records your name as approver. Nothing is sent automatically.
dialogs.sentHint: Confirms the message was sent outside HRAgents (email client, WhatsApp, …) — the system never sends for you.
dialogs.linkHint: Builds a wa.me link with the queued message prefilled. You send it from WhatsApp, then record the dispatch here.

errors.forbidden: Your role cannot queue candidate messages.
errors.notFound: The candidate or evaluation no longer exists.
errors.conflict: The server refused this message (a recorded decision may be missing, or an active message already exists).
errors.invalidRecipient: That email address is not valid.
errors.invalidPhone: That WhatsApp number cannot be used.
errors.failed: Could not queue the message. Please try again.

communication.previewTitle: Message as it will be queued
communication.previewBlockedTitle: This rejection cannot be queued yet

scheduling.title: Interview scheduling
scheduling.reconciliationHint: Interviewers have no overlapping slots — coordinate times, then propose again.
scheduling.approvalHint: Confirm the slots below (or cancel/reschedule); the linked approval is signed in your name.

dialog.confirmHint: Confirms these slots and signs the linked approval in your name; the application moves to interview.
dialog.cancelHint: Withdraws the proposal and any pending approval; the application stays where it is.
dialog.rescheduleHint: Supersedes this proposal and recomputes slots from current interviewer availability.

errors.reasonRequired: A reason is required to cancel or reschedule.
errors.approvalRejected: The linked approval was rejected; create a new proposal instead.
errors.forbidden: Your role cannot decide scheduling proposals.
errors.conflict: The proposal cannot be decided in its current state.
errors.failed: Could not record the decision. Please try again.

board.choiceHint: Closing is not one action: withdraw the candidate, or record a rejection sign-off from the review queue.
board.withdrawHint: Withdrawal is not a rejection — it needs a reason, and the candidate simply leaves the process.
board.reasonPlaceholder: Why this move is right (recorded in the audit log)
board.systemOwned: Extraction and scoring stages are set by the system — dragging cannot change them.

errors.needSignoff: Record the rejection sign-off in the review queue first; the board follows.
errors.needScheduling: Scheduling needs a proposal or an approved override first.
errors.noop: That card is already in this stage.
errors.notEvaluated: This application has no evaluation to sign off yet.
errors.forbidden: Your role cannot move pipeline cards.
errors.conflict: That move is not allowed from the current stage.
errors.failed: Could not move the card. Please try again.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

onboarding.boardHint: Blocked and overdue hires first. Starting a plan records who created it.

checklist.title: Onboarding checklist
checklist.hint: Ordered by what needs a human now: overdue work, then documents, then tasks.
checklist.empty: Pick a plan to work through its checklist.

actions.completeHint: Records your name and closes the step for this plan.
actions.waiveHint: A waiver needs a reason and stays on the audit trail.
actions.requiredStepNotice: This step is required: waiving it is an audited exception, recorded with your name and reason.
actions.conflict: The server refused this change (the step may already be finished, or the plan is gone).

startDialog.title: Start onboarding
startDialog.hint: Pick an existing hire or add the new one here. The plan records who started it.
startDialog.noTemplates: No template yet. Create the starter checklist (it comes from the server, not the browser).

linkDialog.title: Link a document
linkDialog.hint: Pick a document already on file for this hire; onboarding never uploads files.
linkDialog.noDocuments: No documents on file yet. Add them in the Records workspace.

fields.reasonHint: Required. Stored on the audit chain with your name.

errors.forbidden: Your role cannot change onboarding steps.
errors.conflict: The server refused this change (a required step cannot be waived).
errors.invalid: Some of those details are not valid.
errors.failed: Could not save. Please try again.

records.noOrgUnits: No org units yet. Create one from the API or seed it.
records.vaultHint: Expiry alerts first. Verifying or rejecting a document always records the name of the person who decided.
records.noDocuments: Nothing expiring. Add documents to an employee in the API to build the vault.

errors.failed: Could not save. Please try again.

leave.cancelFailed: The request could not be cancelled.
leave.balancesPick: Pick a person to see what they have left this year.
leave.cancelReasonPlaceholder: What changed? This is the record read later.
leave.cancelReasonRequired: Cancelling needs a reason: it withdraws time off somebody already planned around.

payroll.createFailed: The run could not be created.
payroll.actionFailed: That action was refused. The run may need a reason or may be past that stage.
payroll.signoffBlockedHint: Resolve the blocking issues first. Sign-off is refused while any remain.
payroll.noLines: No computed lines yet. Compute the run to see the payslip.
payroll.notice: REVIEW PACKET ONLY — HRAgents does not execute payments. Verify every figure against current regulations before disbursing.
payroll.cancelReasonPlaceholder: What went wrong with this run?
payroll.cancelReasonRequired: Cancelling discards a computed run, so it needs a reason.

offboarding.actionFailed: That action was refused. A waiver needs a reason, and the plan may not be in that state.

growth.progressNote: Progress recorded from the growth board.
growth.assignmentsEmpty: No review is assigned to you.
growth.submitFailed: That review was refused. A submission needs ratings and comments, and the cycle must be in review.

compliance.allTablesVerified: Every rate table is verified against a source.
compliance.auditHint: A second person should be able to check the log. The verifier records who ran it from the authenticated session, not from a name typed into a box.
compliance.verifyFailed: That verification could not be completed.
compliance.noPendingErasures: No erasure request is awaiting a decision.
compliance.executeWarning: Executing destroys the records it touches. The audit trail keeps only the outcome.
compliance.erasureActionFailed: That action was refused. A request must have its identity verified first, and a decision belongs to a named human in the approvals inbox.
compliance.breachActionFailed: That action was refused. A breach moves forward one status at a time, and closing needs every required step done.
compliance.scanHint: A scan only reports. Nothing is destroyed until a purge is run, and a purge needs a named human.
compliance.sourceNotePlaceholder: Where did this figure come from?
compliance.verifyTableFailed: That verification was refused. A rate table needs a source note naming where the figure came from.

approvals.empty: Nothing is waiting on a decision.
approvals.noneYoursToDecide: None of these are yours to decide.
approvals.decideFailed: That decision was refused. It may already have been decided, it may be assigned to another role, or you may have raised it yourself.
approvals.reasonRequired: A rejection needs a reason: it is the record a person reads later.

blocked.ownRequest: You raised this one, so it is not yours to decide.
blocked.unknownViewer: Your role is unknown, so no decision is offered here.
